newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe orders AIDS/HIV tests for rape victims.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe orders AIDS/HIV tests for rape victims.

text.p: A Zimbabwean high court judge ordered on Monday the ministry of health to start conducting compulsory HIV and AIDS tests on rape victims, saying many were at risk of infection from their attackers.

In a speech at the opening of a high court circuit in Zimbabwe's central town of Gweru, Justice Misheck Cheda said rape had become a serious crime in the wake of AIDS, and the medical tests would help the courts to pass long jail penalties.
Police -- although not giving figures -- say cases of rape have been rising in the southern African state in the past three years.
"These cases call for severe penalties in view of the fact that an infected victim clearly faces the possibility of death as a result," the judge said.
Health officials estimate that at least 10 percent of Zimbabwe's over 10 million people have HIV, the virus that causes the AIDS killer disease.
